result.description: TRECS ELECTRICAL PTY LTD  Trecs Electrical Pty Ltd      Location:  Rockhampton, Queensland    Employment Type:  Full-time, Permanent   Hours:  38 hours per week   POSITION PURPOSE   The Electrician is responsible for installing, testing, commissioning, maintaining, repairing and modifying electrical systems, equipment and wiring for domestic, commercial and industrial clients. The role ensures all electrical work is completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with Australian Standards, statutory requirements and company procedures.            Benefits  Work vehicle   Task & responsibilities   KEY RESPONSIBILITIES   The Electrician will be responsible for, but not limited to:   Installing, testing, commissioning, maintaining and repairing electrical wiring, equipment, switchboards, lighting systems and electrical installations.  Reading and interpreting electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, specifications and technical documentation to determine installation requirements.  Measuring, marking out and installing electrical wiring, conduits, cables and associated equipment.  Connecting electrical systems, switchboards, distribution boards and equipment to power supplies.  Testing electrical installations using specialised testing equipment to verify safety, functionality and compliance with Australian Standards.  Diagnosing electrical faults and carrying out repairs or replacing defective wiring, equipment and components.  Installing and commissioning communications cabling, data cabling, security systems, smoke alarms and associated electrical equipment.  Installing electrical components associated with air conditioning systems in accordance with applicable licensing requirements.  Performing preventative and reactive maintenance on domestic, commercial and industrial electrical systems.  Conducting switchboard upgrades, lighting upgrades, power installations and electrical fit-outs for new and existing buildings.  Ensuring all work complies with the Electrical Safety Act, relevant Australian Standards, workplace health and safety requirements and company procedures.  Liaising with clients, builders, project managers and other trades to coordinate works and ensure projects are completed on time.  Completing job documentation, testing records, compliance certificates and service reports accurately.  Maintaining tools, equipment and company vehicles in a safe and serviceable condition.    Qualification & experience   SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE    Essential    Certificate III in Electrotechnology Electrician (or equivalent recognised qualification).  Current Queensland Electrical Work Licence.  Minimum three (3) years' relevant post-qualification experience as an Electrician.  Demonstrated experience undertaking domestic, commercial and industrial electrical installations and maintenance.  Ability to read and interpret electrical plans, wiring diagrams and technical specifications.  Sound knowledge of the AS/NZS 3000 Wiring Rules and relevant Australian Standards.  Experience using electrical testing and diagnostic equipment.  Strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills.  Excellent communication and customer service skills.  Current unrestricted Australian Driver Licence.  Ability to work independently and as part of a team.    Desirable    Restricted or unrestricted Air Conditioning Licence.  Open Cabling Registration.  Experience installing data and communications cabling.  Experience installing CCTV, security and access control systems.  Elevated Work Platform (EWP), Working at Heights, CPR/LVR and White Card certifications.      About Company    Trecs Electrical Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based electrical contracting company providing high-quality domestic, commercial and industrial electrical services throughout Brisbane, Rockhampton and surrounding regions. The company specialises in electrical installations, maintenance, communications and data cabling, air conditioning installations, security systems, switchboard upgrades, lighting solutions and electrical services for new construction and refurbishment projects. Trecs Electrical is committed to delivering safe, reliable and efficient electrical solutions while maintaining the highest standards of workmanship and customer service.       Salary:  $83200-98200   Job Publish:  03-07-2026   Job Expire:  02-08-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5974803   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.

 Operate and monitor bagging line machine 
 Ensure smooth and efficient production line operation 
 Perform basic troubleshooting and report faults as required 
 Maintain a clean and safe working environment 
 Follow all safety and quality procedures 
 
    Requirements:   
 
 2-5 years of experience in a manufacturing or production environment 
 Previous experience operating bagging, packaging, or automated production machinery preferred 
 Strong technical and mechanical aptitude 
 Ability to identify and resolve basic machine faults 
 Good attention to detail and commitment to quality 
 Ability to work day and afternoon shifts 
 Previous food manufacturing or packing experience 
 
    Who are we?     As one of Australia's largest employers, we work with great companies all around Australia and New Zealand to give you the best opportunities to work when and where you want to.    At Programmed, we are committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment which values and respects diverse styles, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.
